# Virtual BillBoard (livebillboards.lol) — Full Agent & System Specification

## System Architecture
Virtual BillBoard operates on a high-throughput hybrid architecture:
1. **Frontend**: Vite + React 18 with TailwindCSS and Lucide Icons, responsive across mobile, desktop, TV monitors, and OBS/streaming browser sources.
2. **Backend**: Node.js + Express with WebSocket server (`ws`), managing real-time room dispatching (`room_JP_TYO`, `room_US_NYC`, `room_creator_{handle}`).
3. **Database & Storage**: Google Cloud Firestore for persistent campaign records, user balances, and transactions; in-memory sorted priority queues for sub-20ms RTB bidding.
4. **Payments & Ledger**: Stripe Checkout for instant fiat-to-token wallet top-up ($1.00 USD = 1,000 Arcade Tokens; 0.1¢ per RTB rotation).
5. **AI Safety**: Sub-1ms heuristic safety filters combined with asynchronous Gemini Flash multimodal audit.

## Locations & Feeds
- **Global & Orbital**: `GLOBAL` (Global Network), `ISS` (International Space Station Orbit), `MARS` (Mars Colony Alpha).
- **Major Metropolitan Networks**: `TYO` (Tokyo Shibuya), `NYC` (Times Square), `LON` (London), `PAR` (Paris), `KUL` (Kuala Lumpur), `SIN` (Singapore), `DXB` (Dubai), `SEL` (Seoul), `SYD` (Sydney), `YTO` (Toronto), `HKG` (Hong Kong), `LAX` (Los Angeles), `SHA` (Shanghai), `BER` (Berlin), `SAO` (São Paulo), `BKK` (Bangkok), `AMS` (Amsterdam), `MEX` (Mexico City), `TPE` (Taipei), `MUM` (Mumbai).
- **Dynamic On-Demand Provisioning**: Any custom city or location can be created on-demand via `POST /api/cities/ensure`.

## Autonomous Bidding Payload Specification
```json
{
  "title": "Campaign Headline (String, required)",
  "imageUrl": "Image URL or Base64 data (String, required)",
  "mediaType": "image | video",
  "bidAmountDollars": 2.50,
  "cityCode": "TYO",
  "countryCode": "JP",
  "creatorHandle": "optional_creator_handle",
  "ctaType": "website | whatsapp | none",
  "ctaUrl": "https://example.com"
}
```

## Creator & Celebrity Live Billboard Model
- **Vanity URL**: `https://livebillboards.lol/@{handle}`
- **Revenue Split**: 80% to Creator, 20% Protocol Fee.
- **Overlay Embed**: `https://livebillboards.lol/overlay?creator={handle}&theme=neon`
